audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart was off by one against its own whys on both layers: the page said Wukong wins Level 1 while whys[0] says 'even opener', said K'Sante wins Levels 3-5 while whys[2] and whys[3] say Wukong dominates before 6, and gave Wukong Level 6 while whys[4] says All Out flips the duel.
audit.why: The mirror (ksante__wukong) already realigned all seven rows to Skill / Wukong / Wukong / Wukong / K'Sante / Skill / Wukong, and the packet chart matches it exactly.
audit.corrected: All seven rows written as matched pairs on both layers, ratings inverted to follow, and phases[1..6].why rewritten to the row they now describe.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3..6].why were template strings, and spikes called K'Sante's ultimate 'Ultimate Form'.
audit.why: The ability is All Out. The spike shape is: your window is 2 through 5, his is level 6 at 120s, first item is even while he stacks armour, and two items is where All Out's own defence penalty makes him punishable.
audit.corrected: Phase whys and spikes[1]/[3] rewritten with the real name and the 120s / 250-range numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page had K'Sante's ability slots wrong. It called Ntofo Strikes his W ('Ntofo Strikes (W)', 'landing his W chain', 'three W hits to shred and root you', 'his W stacks'). Ntofo Strikes is Q; W is Path Maker. It also said two stacks root — they pull.
audit.why: Riot's text: Q 'grants a stack of Ntofo Strikes. At 2 stacks, K'Sante fires a shockwave that pulls enemies in', on a flat 3.5s cooldown. W Path Maker is the 14s charge-dash that knocks back and stuns — and All Out REMOVES that knockback and stun, which is the interaction that decides whether his engage can lock you at all. A player told to fear a 'three-hit W root' will play the wrong spacing on the wrong ability.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected everywhere they appeared; pull replaces root; Ntofo Strikes 3.5s flat and Path Maker 14s stated; All Out's loss of stun noted in the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers and two placeholder bullets.
audit.why: Ntofo Strikes at 3.5s cannot be waited out; Path Maker at 14s and All Out at 120s can.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.

edits.before: W clone bails out any misstep and baits his answer. Only take the trade when K'Sante's All Out is down.
edits.after: You spike first at 2 — his early damage is thin. Trade before Ntofo Strikes reaches its second stack.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so K'Sante must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online. Ntofo Strikes is a flat 3.5s, so two stacks pull fast — trade after the second, not into it.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around All Out's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: He cannot win a straight duel before 6. Engage into a spent Path Maker (14s) — the stun is his only real reset.

edits.before: Cyclone’s double knockup wins every committed brawl. Reassess every all-in at 6 — K'Sante's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: All Out (120s at rank 1) launches you through a wall and flips the duel. Never sit at even HP inside its 250 range.

edits.before: Black Cleaver is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on All Out's cooldown.
edits.after: Even here — Cleaver restores burst but his armour stacking blunts it. Fight on cooldowns.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. K'Sante carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: All Out sheds his own defences, so his big engage is the moment you punish him. K'Sante carry threat 7/10 — take the side lane.

edits.before: - K'Sante All Out: matchup-defining — His duelist mode. Burst when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - All Out: 120s at rank 1, 250 range — launches you through a wall and strips his own defences. - Ntofo Strikes: a flat 3.5s; two stacks fire a pull. - Path Maker: 14s stun, and All Out removes that stun.

edits.before: His duelist mode. Burst when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 120s at rank 1, and it strips his own defences. Engage once it is spent.

edits.before: Track K'Sante's All Out: His duelist mode. Burst when it’s down. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: All Out is 120s at rank 1 and it sheds his own tank stats. When it is spent — E-Q + R him.

edits.before: Late you reclaim it — his Ultimate Form sheds his tank stats and your R punishes.
edits.after: Late you reclaim it — All Out sheds his own tank stats and your R punishes.

edits.before: With Q, W and E online you own every trade window: E in for the on-hit and attack speed, Q for the armor-shred crush, then W-decoy out before his Ntofo Strikes (Q) stacks can root you. K'Sante is stuck last-hitting because his early damage is anemic and his shred needs three W hits to land.
edits.after: With Q, W and E online you own every trade window: E in for the on-hit and attack speed, Q for the armor-shred crush, then W-decoy out before Ntofo Strikes (Q, 3.5s) hits two stacks and pulls you in. K'Sante is stuck last-hitting because his early damage is anemic and Path Maker is his only stun.

edits.before: This is his window: Ultimate Form (R) turns him into a high-damage, tanky brawler that ignores your armor advantage and can wall-slam you with the recast. Don't sit in his R range at even HP; respect that he now out-duels you until you have items.
edits.after: This is his window: All Out (R, 120s at rank 1, 250 range) turns him into a high-damage brawler and launches you through any wall in your path. Don't sit inside that range at even HP; respect that he out-duels you until you have items.

edits.before: You reclaim the edge: R (Cyclone) knocks up his whole team and your W decoy baits his R engage, and his Ultimate Form deletes his own tank stats so you and your team punish him mid-combo.
edits.after: You reclaim the edge: R (Cyclone) knocks up his whole team, your W decoy baits his All Out, and All Out itself strips his defences — so the moment he commits is the moment you punish him.

edits.before: K'Sante's level 1-2 is weak but his Ntofo Strikes (W) can poke and his passive on-hit adds up, so the opener is a skill-check on spacing rather than a free lane. Last-hit safely and don't walk into a full W root.
edits.after: K'Sante's level 1-2 is weak but Ntofo Strikes (Q, 3.5s) pokes and his passive on-hit adds up, so the opener is a skill-check on spacing rather than a free lane. Last-hit safely and never eat the two-stack pull.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 are yours: E-in, Q the armor crush, auto, and W-decoy out beats his kit until he shreds you. He can't kill you without landing his W chain, and your Q slow lets you disengage the moment he commits. The one caveat is level 6 — once All-Out (R) is up he flips the duel.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 are yours: E-in, Q the armour crush, auto, and W-decoy out beats his kit. He cannot kill you without chaining Ntofo Strikes (Q) to two stacks for the pull, and Path Maker (W, 14s) is his only stun. The caveat is 6 — All Out flips the duel outright.

edits.before: After items it tilts back to you: his Ultimate Form strips his tankiness, your R sets up the knockup, and the W decoy makes his big engage a coinflip he usually loses.
edits.after: After items it tilts back to you: All Out strips his own tankiness, your R sets up the knockup, and the W decoy makes his big engage a coinflip he usually loses.

edits.before: Trade at 3-5 with E-Q while his W stacks are down
edits.after: Trade at 3-5 with E-Q before his Q reaches two stacks

edits.before: Land three W (Ntofo) hits to shred and root you
edits.after: Stack Ntofo Strikes (Q) twice to pull you in

edits.before: Wall-slam you with the R recast for a stun combo
edits.after: Slam you through a wall with All Out and dash in
